app.name: roam-code
app.one_liner: A local-first, agent-centric CLI that provides AI coding agents with deep codebase intelligence and generates tamper-evident evidence packets for every change.

screens.name: Main CLI Interface
screens.purpose: Serve as the primary agent-facing surface for initializing, analyzing, and modifying codebases with built-in safety and evidence generation.

rust_commands.name: roam_health
rust_commands.purpose: Compute a composite 0-100 score based on complexity, cycles, coupling, and dead code to assess codebase health.

rust_commands.name: roam_init
rust_commands.purpose: Index the target repository into a local SQLite database (.roam/index.db) to enable code intelligence queries.

rust_commands.name: roam_preflight
rust_commands.purpose: Analyze blast radius, relevant tests, complexity, and architecture rules for a given symbol before editing.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add basic preflight command with blast radius estimation
week 1: Build initial MCP server integration
week 1: Implement core SQLite schema for symbols, calls, and layers
acceptance_tests: After `roam init`, the .roam/index.db file exists and contains parsed symbols from the repo.
All commands operate without network egress or authentication requirements.
Executing `roam preflight <valid_symbol>` outputs relevant tests, complexity metrics, and architecture rule violations.
Generated ChangeEvidence packets include HMAC-chained logs and signed attestations.
Running `roam health` returns a numeric score between 0 and 100 without error.
